Brightwater Analytics - expense reimbursement policy
1. Flights: economy class; business class is allowed only when the scheduled flight time is more than 6 hours (exactly 6 hours is not enough); every flight must be booked at least 21 days before departure (exactly 21 days is enough; the date of a flight expense is its booking date).
2. Mobile phone bills: no more than CAD 90.00 per month (exactly CAD 90.00 is accepted).
3. Other expense types: a type of expense not named in this policy is reimbursed if it meets the rules on receipts, prior approval and deadlines in this policy.
4. Private car: paid at CAD 0.35 per km driven; trips of more than 250 km are not paid at all (250 km itself is fine); the amount claimed must not be higher than km driven x rate.
5. Prior approval: an expense whose total is above CAD 750.00 (CAD 750.00 itself does not count) is paid only if it was approved beforehand.
6. Deadline: an expense must be submitted within 45 days of its expense date (the expense date is day 0; a submission on day 45 is still in time).
7. Approved expenses are paid with the next monthly salary.
8. Receipts: a receipt must be attached to every expense whose total is above CAD 20.00 (CAD 20.00 itself does not count); private-car mileage never needs one.
9. Equipment: an item costing CAD 250.00 or more needs prior approval, in addition to any other approval rule in this policy.
10. Client gifts: no more than CAD 25.00 per recipient (exactly CAD 25.00 is accepted); gift vouchers and cash are never paid for.
11. Corporate cards are issued on request; their monthly limit is CAD 5,000.00.
An expense is paid back in full only when it complies with all of the rules relevant to it.

8. Approved expenses are paid with the next monthly salary.
If any rule relevant to an expense is broken, the expense is not paid back in full.

9. Meals: the cost per person (the total divided by the number of people) may be below SGD 60.00 (exactly SGD 60.00 is not accepted); drinks containing alcohol are paid for only when a client attended the meal.
Rules written for a different kind of expense do not matter here; an expense is paid in full only when all rules relevant to it are met.

1. Exchange-rate differences are booked by finance and are never part of an expense.
2. Prior approval: an expense whose total is SGD 600.00 or more is paid only if it was approved beforehand.
3. Team leads review expense reports once a week.
4. Other expense types: a type of expense not named in this policy is reimbursed if it meets the rules on receipts, prior approval and deadlines in this policy.
5. Receipts: a receipt must be attached to every expense whose total is above SGD 50.00 (SGD 50.00 itself does not count).
6. Flights: economy class; business class is allowed only when the scheduled flight time is 4 hours or more.
7. Taxis: below SGD 75.00 per ride (exactly SGD 75.00 is not accepted); a ride is paid only if it starts at 21:00 or later or before 06:00, or, at any time of day, if it goes to or from an airport.
8. Hotels: room rate below SGD 90.00 per night (exactly SGD 90.00 is not accepted); in Antwerp, Bilbao, Turin or Bergen the limit is SGD 130.00 per night instead, with the same rule at the limit.
9. Meals: the cost per person (the total divided by the number of people) may be below SGD 60.00 (exactly SGD 60.00 is not accepted); drinks containing alcohol are paid for only when a client attended the meal.
Rules written for a different kind of expense do not matter here; an expense is paid in full only when all rules relevant to it are met.

4. Other expense types: a type of expense not named in this policy is reimbursed if it meets the rules on receipts, prior approval and deadlines in this policy.
5. Questions about this policy go to the finance team.
6. Corporate cards are issued on request; their monthly limit is SGD 5,000.00.
7. Meals: the cost per person (the total divided by the number of people) may be no more than SGD 30.00 (exactly SGD 30.00 is accepted); drinks containing alcohol are not paid for.
8. Team leads review expense reports once a week.
An expense is paid back in full only when it complies with all of the rules relevant to it.
